import sys,time,random,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from common import validate
from planning import solve
R=int(sys.argv[1]);O=int(sys.argv[2]);P=int(sys.argv[3])
NQ=4096;NOQ=4096;CH=128;DEPTH=32
# request chains one group per node, request i group i
rq=[]
for i in range(NQ):
 d=i%DEPTH
 rq.append({'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if d==0 else f'n{i-1}','capacity':max(0,DEPTH-d-1)})
# offer chains, 2 offers per node
oq=[]
for i in range(NOQ):
 d=i%DEPTH
 offers_in_subtree=2*(DEPTH-d)
 oq.append({'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if d==0 else f'n{i-1}','capacity':max(0,offers_in_subtree-1)})
leases=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8::/56','start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}]
services=[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}]
random.seed(9)
reqs=[]
for i in range(R):reqs.append({'id':f'r{i}','at':0,'lease':'l','target':f'2001:db8:{(i>>16)&0xffff:x}:{i&0xffff:x}::1','service':'s','group':f'n{i%NQ}'})
offers=[]
for j in range(O):
 # group two offers per node
 g=j//2
 listed=[f'r{(j*37+k*127)%R}' for k in range(P)]
 offers.append({'id':f'o{j}','time':random.randrange(0,101),'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':1,'cost':random.randrange(0,10**9),'group':f'n{g}','requests':listed})
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':leases,'services':services,'queries':[0],'captures':[],'requests':reqs,'offers':offers,'request_quotas':rq,'offer_quotas':oq}
t=time.time();ctx=validate(job);print('validated',time.time()-t)
active={f'r{i}':True for i in range(R)}
t=time.time();res=solve(ctx,active);dt=time.time()-t
print('solved',dt,'resolved',res['resolved'],'cost',res['cost'],'rss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
EOF
